scope.summary: Implement persistent symmetric-link editing (CG-05, MD Unfold Symmetric Editing with Sewing): a symmetry pairing between two panels (or halves) where outline/internal/sewing edits mirror live until unlinked, including per-internal-line unlink (MD 2026.0), CRDT-safe per Section 13.6/13.11.
acceptance_criteria: symmetry_link(panel_a, panel_b, axis) records a persistent link; edits to either side mirror to the other (vertices, edges, internal lines, darts/pleats, seams where the seam target is also mirrored).
unlink_symmetry(panel_id) and per-internal-line unlink break propagation without altering current geometry.
Concurrent CRDT edits to both halves converge deterministically (mirror op ordering defined; test with two writers).
Half-pattern unfold (MT-125 sibling) can promote into a symmetric-link pair instead of a one-shot mirror copy.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without persistent sewing-aware symmetry, every bilateral garment edit must be made twice and drifts; MD users treat this as table-stakes.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
